description: Who is connected: the FilmLab account (email, user id, name, tier, credits) and how this connection signed in (oauth, oauth_geraet, bridge_key, legacy service user, or anonym). For a device sign-in it also lists the device limits (projects, credits, end date). Call it when results look like someone else's — two clients signed in with two accounts see different projects. Works without an account. Read-only, free.
name: lab_whoami
title: Who Am I
